outcome_verbatim: 'At 2-year follow-up, 21.2% (n = 31) of the participants had competitive employment. notes: Coded vocational_activity, NOT paid_competitive and NOT paid_any: the job is in an ordinary workplace but is financed by NAV through work assessment allowance or disability benefits with no salary from the employer, so it is an unpaid placement in a competitive setting. evensen2017 itself pools it with competitive work when it writes 'as many as 46.5% worked in ordinary workplaces with pay or social security benefits at 2-year follow-up' (p. 185); that 46.5 per cent composite mixes paid and unpaid and is not extracted as an employment result.
